Asset type: one square illustration for an English vocabulary memory card.
Exact target sense: "grateful" / adj. / "感激的".
Sense context (not image text): I am grateful for your help. 我很感激你的帮助。
Primary request: depict only this exact sense in a concrete readable scene.
Scene: Two adult friends in a simple garden setting. One friend has just helped pick up several dropped plain books and is returning them. The recipient has a relieved warm smile, one open hand resting over her heart and a slight appreciative bow, making her grateful expression central. The helper's offered books clearly explain the reason for gratitude. No writing on books. Show thanks for help, not merely giving a gift.
Style/medium: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper, soft daylight, natural muted green, blue and coral, matching gentle garden vocabulary illustrations.
Composition: one coherent tightly related scene centered within the middle 70 percent, generous empty paper margins, main subjects entirely visible and clear at small card size.
Constraints: no written words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, borders, arrows, card UI or generic stock icons. No unrelated objects.
